Proposition
[Volume-normalized Ricci--DeTurck equations (36.2--36.5)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0332, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0333 ↗ def:chow-iv-rotational-s3-metric 1. ch36:eq-36.2,eq-36.3,eq-36.4,eq-36.5\group Numerical Simulation

For the metric in Definition 2, the volume-normalized Ricci--DeTurck flow is the $1+1$ initial-boundary value problem \begin{align*} X_t={}& e^{2(W-X)}\! \bigl[X”+2\cot \psi X’-2+\tfrac 12((X’)^2+(W’)^2) +3X’W’ \\[-2pt]& \qquad +(1-e^{-4W})\bigl(\tfrac 1{2\sin ^2\psi }+1+2\cot \psi W’\bigr)\bigr] +\tfrac {\hat r}{3},\\ S_t={}& e^{2(W-X)}\! \bigl[S”+6\cot \psi S’-8S -\frac{3(1-4W-e^{-4W})}{2\sin ^4\psi }\\[-2pt]& \qquad +\frac{1-e^{-4W}}{\sin ^2\psi } \bigl(1-2(\cot \psi X’+2\sin \psi \cos \psi S’+4\cos ^2\psi S)\bigr)\\[-2pt]& \qquad -\tfrac 12\bigl((X’/\sin \psi )^2+(\sin \psi S’+2\cos \psi S)^2 +6(X’/\sin \psi )(\sin \psi S’+2\cos \psi S)\bigr)\bigr], \end{align*} where \[ \hat r=\frac2N\int _0^\pi e^{X+3W}\bigl(e^{-4W}-1-4\sin \psi \cos \psi W' +\sin ^2\psi [3+(X'+W')^2]\bigr)\, d\psi , \quad N=\int _0^\pi e^{3X+W}\sin ^2\psi \, d\psi . \]
